subject: Lynx Health: SOC2 evidence + SSO/encryption architecture deep-dive — scheduling
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@lynxhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tracy Luo <tracy.luo@lynxhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Request: security architecture review for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Stephanie —

Hope you had a good holiday break. We're evaluating a handful of vendors for our upcoming SOC 2 assessment window (Q2) and would like to schedule a focused architecture review with Redwood to validate evidence around SSO, encryption at-rest/in-transit, and audit/log retention.

High-level ask: a 60–75 minute deep-dive where your security or solutions team can walk through the architecture, point us to locations of artifacts (audit logs, retention policies, key management) and confirm what evidence we should expect for the audit.

Potential windows (EST):
- Jan 17: 10:00–11:15 or 15:00–16:15
- Jan 18: 09:00–10:15
- Jan 19: 14:00–15:15

I'll loop in Tracy from engineering and procurement once we lock a time. Attendees from our side will be me (security lead) and Tracy (platform eng), plus procurement if we need to cover contractual timelines.

I attached our SOC2_questions.csv — short list of mandatory artifacts to confirm availability ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Security, Lynx Health
--- Attachment: SOC2_questions.csv (text/csv, 14KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@lynxhealth.com>
Cc: Tracy Luo <tracy.luo@lynxhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: security architecture review for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for the note and for sharing the questions. We'd be happy to run the deep-dive. Monica (Solutions Engineering) and Rishi (Security) are on copy — they typically lead the technical walkthroughs and evidence mapping.

We're available for a 60–75 minute session; suggested windows (PST):
- Jan 18: 10:00–11:15 PST (13:00–14:15 EST)
- Jan 19: 14:00–15:15 PST (17:00–18:15 EST)

If those don't work, we can also do Jan 20 in the morning. Please tell us which slot you prefer and whether you want us to share an architecture diagram and a pre-call checklist ahead of time (we can upload to a shared Drive).

Preliminary agenda we propose:
1) Quick intros & goals (5–10m)
2) Architecture walkthrough (SSO, key management, encryption at-rest/in-transit) (25–30m)
3) Audit logs & retention — where evidence lives (15–20m)
4) Evidence mapping and next steps / deliverables (10–15m)

We'll include a short recording permission note and can redact any customer names in shared artifacts.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
From: Tracy Luo <tracy.luo@lynxhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Jan 2027 11:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: security architecture review for SOC 2 evidence

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick reply, Stephanie. Apologies — Jan 18/19 are tight for us because of a vendor freeze that week. Can we move this to Jan 20? Prefer morning EST (09:30–10:45 or 10:00–11:15).

Procurement would like to be included on the call to quick-check timing impact to our contracting window — looping procurement@lynxhealth.com.

Agenda looks good. A couple of asks from our side:
- Please include the network/application diagram and a short evidence checklist in Drive before the call.
- Confirm whether you can share an example audit-log extract (anonymized) so our auditors can validate format.

Thanks,
Tracy Luo
Platform Engineering, Lynx Health
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Hi Tracy / Daniel —

Jan 20 works for us. We can do 09:30–10:30 EST (60m) to fit your morning window — is that acceptable? We'll aim to keep it tight and will follow up with an extended Q&A doc if needed.

Per your asks:
- We'll upload the architecture diagram and a one-page evidence checklist to Drive by EOD Jan 11.
- We can provide an anonymized audit-log extract as a PDF sample and point to the log retention policy in the evidence checklist.

Attachments (sent): redwood-soc2-evidence-guidance.pdf (guides expected artifacts + sample retention policies), arch-diagram-v2.svg (high-level infra diagram).

Proposed attendees from Redwood (confirmed):
- Stephanie Nguyen — Solutions lead (moderator)
- Monica Patel — Solutions Engineer (walkthrough + demo)
- Rishi Malhotra — Security (KMS/encryption & audit logs)

Action items:
- Lynx: confirm 09:30–10:30 EST on Jan 20 and add procurement contact to the invite
- Redwood: upload Drive folder and share link; attach anonymized log sample before the call

Thanks,
Stephanie
